title: NAV online invoices
html:
Customer invoices

The list of invoices that have been issued and uploaded to the NAV Online system, and the place where resending and checking are carried out.

The statuses:

DONE (green) Submitted successfully, nothing to do
ABORTED / BAD (pink) The invoice was not submitted, or was submitted unsuccessfully — manual upload is required on the NAV interface

Supplier invoices

Infinity also downloads the invoices issued to us from the NAV system.

Clicking the eye icon lets you view the details of the invoice:

The items can be matched with the products stored in the product list, or a new one can be created. After that, the supplier invoice can easily be recorded in the system.
